videos.script: Lesson 11 left the planner with a store in a global object and a factory written by hand. This lesson hands that wiring to Hilt. {{hand}} First, what injection is, with no library at all. A class is given what it needs. You have been doing it since lesson 10. {{setup}} Then Hilt in the build. Two plugins, an application class, one line in the manifest, one annotation on the activity. {{modules}} Then modules, for what you cannot annotate. An interface and a clock. {{vm}} Then the ViewModel, with its factory deleted. {{generated}} Then the code Hilt wrote, twenty-two files of it. And a module taken away on purpose, so the build fails and names what is missing. {{test}} And last, a test that swaps the store and stops the clock. The real screen, the real ViewModel, and a date the computer did not have.
